blocks.text: LEGAZPI CITY — The Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) intends to expand the use of atmospheric water generators (AWGs) in water-insecure communities as the country copes with a strong El Niño. Social Welfare Secretary Rex Gatchalian led a benchmarking visit to Gilotongan Island in Cawayan, Masbate, on Wednesday to showcase a solar-powered facility that extracts moisture from the air and converts it into potable water. The activity brought together DSWD officials and local government representatives from Regions IV-A, IV-B, VII, X and XIII to assess the technology’s operations, cost and potential for replication in geographically isolated and disaster-prone communities.
